name: Smash 'N Grab
storyline:
In a neon-soaked Las Vegas ruled by the mob, Smash is a hulking robot who plays jazz drums in smoky back-room clubs. When a gig goes bad, the mob decides he knows too much. They haul him out to a scrapyard in the desert and put a bullet in his head.

But they do not quite finish the job.

That same night, Grab, a cunning raccoon with big dreams and sticky fingers, is prowling the scrapyard looking for treasure. Instead, he finds Smash.

Seeing an opportunity, Grab patches the robot back together and spins him a story. Together they will take down the mob and return the wealth they have stolen to the people of the city.

Smash believes every word.

Grab, however, has a different plan. With Smash's brute strength and his own cunning, the two of them can pull off the greatest string of heists Las Vegas has ever seen.

Smash thinks they are saving the city. Grab thinks he is getting rich.

But somewhere between the explosions, the loot, and the chaos, Grab might start to wonder if there is more to the job than the score.
summary: Smash ‘N Grab is a destructive, speedrunning beat ’em up starring Smash and Grab - a robot and raccoon duo pulling off explosive heists. Tethered by a rope, they race against the clock for the perfect score!
